gen-gf-offside-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee sets chunky, tall lowercase letters that come across as clean and approachable. And Offside, with stout pipe-cleaner strokes and curves that refuse to close, speaks up while Mukta Mahee works quietly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar is a sans-serif with compressed ascenders, while Offside brings stencil-cut letters of one steady width and widely tracked spacing. Paragraphs would move along smoothly and without fuss.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani is a contemporary, neutral sans-serif, its lowercase built high-waisted. Mukta Vaani stays out of the way while Offside, its ink looking poured at one width, takes the big, short lines.
gen-gf-offside-gf-narnoor: Narnoor keeps its ascenders short above big bowls, which sits quietly beside Offside's flat gray hum of constant line weight. Extended reading would feel measured, steady and quite unfussy.
gen-gf-offside-gf-roboto-condensed: Curves that refuse to close give Offside its expressive, commanding look. Roboto Condensed does the quiet work, packing words so tightly the line glides under the eye like wire.
gen-gf-offside-gf-smooch-sans: Expressive and commanding, Offside draws stencil-cut letters of one steady width with widely tracked spacing. Smooch Sans supplies the standout quality, a closely packed line where gaps nearly vanish.
gen-gf-offside-gf-voces: Offside shows no visible difference between up and side strokes, while Voces builds tall lowercase with stems and hairlines in close ratio. Paragraphs would settle into a steady, composed rhythm.
gen-gf-offside-gf-winky-rough: Tubular, wire-like letterforms give Offside its expressive, commanding shape. Winky Rough keeps its lowercase nearly level with the capitals, so sans-serif text running on would feel contemporary and professional.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-amulya: Oxanium's uninterrupted monoline strokes carry a high x-height. Amulya, with a moderate lowercase and generous gaps in its curves, gives the heading room to be loud while the text stays modern.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-alumni-sans: Distinctive and commanding, Oxanium draws every letter with a marker-like constant line. Oxanium belongs in big, short lines, while Alumni Sans adds the slight heft change of a stone-carved inscription.
